lines.speaker: veronica
lines.text: Thanks for calling City Centre Dentistry, Dr. Mand's office — this is the front desk. How can I help you today?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hi there — so I've been thinking about getting Botox for a little while now, and honestly maybe Invisalign too somewhere down the road. I just wasn't sure what something like that usually costs, so I figured I'd call and ask before I got too far ahead of myself.

lines.speaker: veronica
lines.text: Absolutely — those are two of the things Dr. Mand does a lot of here at City Centre, so you've definitely called the right place. Pricing really depends on your specific situation, so rather than give you a number that might be off, what we do is a free consultation — Dr. Mand takes a look, walks you through your options for both the Botox and the Invisalign, and gives you an exact estimate right there. No cost, no obligation at all. Would you like me to get that booked for you?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Oh, it's actually free? That's great, yeah — I'd definitely like to come in for that. I didn't realize the consultation wouldn't cost anything, so that makes it a lot easier to just come check it out.

lines.speaker: veronica
lines.text: Of course — no pressure at all, it's just a chance to get your questions answered. Have you seen Dr. Mand before, or would this be your first time visiting City Centre?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: No, this would be my very first time — I've actually been looking for a new place for a while, so hopefully this works out.

lines.speaker: veronica
lines.text: Well, welcome — I think you'll really like it here. I'll get you set up as a new patient so everything's ready when you arrive. Can I start with your first and last name?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Yeah, for sure — it's Jordan Lee.

lines.speaker: veronica
lines.text: Thanks, Jordan. And what's the best phone number to reach you at, just in case we need to confirm anything before your visit?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Yeah, no problem — it's six oh four, five five five, oh one four two.

lines.speaker: veronica
lines.text: Perfect, got it. Dr. Mand has a free consultation opening this Thursday at 2:30, or Friday morning at 10 — would either of those work for you?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Um, Thursday at 2:30 would be great actually — that works really well with my schedule.

lines.speaker: veronica
lines.text: Wonderful — you're all set, Jordan. Thursday at 2:30 with Dr. Mand for a free consult on the Botox and Invisalign, and I've got you in our system as a new patient. We'll send you a text reminder the day before so you don't have to think about it. Is there anything else I can help you with?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: No, that's everything — thank you so much, I really appreciate your help.

lines.speaker: veronica
lines.text: My pleasure, Jordan — we're looking forward to seeing you Thursday. Take care now!
